items.title: Meta spend 2026-09-24 to 09-30: $343.21, 22 leads, CPL $15.60
items.summary: Seven-day window (no prior meta-ads.json found in the last 7 days). Flooring Problems Campaign was the only campaign with delivery: $343.21 spend, 22 leads, 241 clicks, 10,341 impressions.

needs_attention: No meta-ads.json found for the prior 7 days, so the window was widened to 7 days (2026-09-24 to 2026-09-30); metrics cover the week, not a single day.
No separate CPL baseline pull was made (the window is the baseline), so no anomaly comparisons were run.
